workload.content: three overlapping opaque/translucent rectangles per card

producer_and_caller_proof.producer: Closed LayerStackEntry has Clip/Opacity/Blend only. Exhaustive GPU conversion and sole full/partial upload producer preserve tags. Opacity/blend constructors always encode paths without SDF/shadow; public draw mutations edit brushes only. Append preserves path/SDF category; offscreen remaps draw identity without changing kind.
producer_and_caller_proof.caller: All scalar/parallel/chunk emitter callers accept wrapper count for the same immutable input buffers. Writes target separate coarse_work; invalid path backdrop and empty coverage are rejected before emission. Full coverage clip elision remains semantic work.
producer_and_caller_proof.fixture_correction: Opaque fixture replaced all draws with SDF paint records, inadvertently turning its layer boundary into an impossible SDF opacity. Preserve a dedicated path boundary outside the paint list. Particle oracle remains unchanged. Obsolete unsupported-tag active fixture becomes an empty path clip; outside-active-range sentinel stays.
producer_and_caller_proof.new_tests: Typed producer and six mixed-stack cases passed before production edits. Initial test development corrected oracle assumptions about encoded SDF length (at least 9, actual17) and per-chunk class (SDF2, wrappers handled later). These are not production bug red regressions.
producer_and_caller_proof.pending_test_harness_policy: Metal raw coarse Routes::new uses validation=true and default adapter rather than explicitly enforcing TILEINK_TEST_GPU despite ignored-test text. Host has one M5; temporary workload explicitly pins it. Add focused policy regression before changing harness in future.
producer_and_caller_proof.preserved: Coverage/bounds rejection, launch/capacity/ownership validation and precise SDF proof constraints remain. No public API compatibility shim.

conclusion: No stable material regression or attributable speedup in these full-process workloads; all comparison descriptive paired intervals include zero and identical-current controls also vary.
platform_limit: Actual DXC compilation, reflection and Windows Rust checks pass; DX12/Vulkan GPU execution and the real ShaderTools server remain unavailable on this macOS host.
semantic_test_before_after: Producer and mixed-stack semantic cases passed with unchanged production before shader edits and pass again after cleanup. Raw invalid-tag and impossible SDF-opacity fixtures are corrected without relaxing particle expectations.
